prompt: How many votes did the opposition party get in the Brant riding the election before Justin Trudeau was elected Prime Minister?
answer: In the 2011 federal election—the election before Justin Trudeau became prime minister—the New Democratic Party (the Official Opposition) received **16,351 votes** in the Brant riding.
